cases.name: Laken Hope Riley
cases.about:
Riley was a UGA student up until the spring semester of 2023 before she transferred to the Augusta University College of Nursing program at Athens. She was enrolled as a junior and on the Dean's List. 

The nursing school in a statement said Riley, who received her honorary white coat last August and was slated to graduate in 2025, had a "promising future" as a nurse.
cases.narrative: On 2/22/2024, her body was found behind Lake Herrick in the forested area on UGA's campus.

cases.name: Ollie Jean Hamilton
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Ollie Jean Hamilton, 72, a cherished member of the Athens community and a dedicated cook at Taco Bell, passed away peacefully on Wednesday, October 29, 2025. She was born on November 1, 1952, in Aberdeen, Monroe County, Mississippi, where she lived her entire life, nurturing countless friendships and family bonds.

Throughout her career at Taco Bell, Ollie Jean was known not only for her culinary skills but also for her warm spirit and willingness to bring joy to those around her. Her delightful personality made her a beloved figure among customers and colleagues alike. Her contributions went beyond just preparing food; she fostered an environment of camaraderie and hospitality.

Ollie Jean was a devoted mother and wife, leaving behind a legacy of love and strength through her family. Ollie Jean Hamilton leaves behind a legacy of love, compassion, and culinary talent that will forever be remembered by those who had the privilege to know her. Her spirit will live on in the hearts of her family and friends, serving as a source of inspiration and enduring love."
